data: A MEASUREMENT DOCUMENT of the chain_select sweep (the project's order 15 October 2026 08:3x UK), entry length 1 step (sequence 128 entries over M 16 shapes, 128 steps). chain_select 1: the NEXT ENTRY'S SHAPE INDEX and the KEYED ITEM'S INDEX are drawn from the previous entry's final lane state rather than from the seed-drawn sequence: at the end of entry e, x = fchain((fold over the 16 lanes of x = (x ^ r0) + r1), 1 + e); entry e + 1's shape is x mod 16 and the keyed reads inside it take index fchain(x, 8192 + t) mod items; the first entry's shape from the seed's sequence and its reads from the seed's word (fchain(seed word 7, 65536)). The drawn sequence is then the hash's own dependent chain: the card learns entry e + 1 only at the end of entry e, so the lookahead for the read and for the shape switch is the entry length (1 step); prefetch and the per-pair sequence are refused beside it. The rest the occupancy form (fp_mode 3: integer-only quota, the 64-byte lane scratchpad, the ILP wiring a = k + 21, b = k + 9), the keyed read every second step (64 items and 16 KiB a hash), the lean fixed cost, the period seed of the chain form (period_blocks 64, the anchor at finality depth 64, F-141), chain 7358. THE SWEEP: l128 (1 step an entry), l64 (2), l32 (4), l16 (8), l8 (16); the GPU team measures the five as mined; the figure of record the card's uJ a hash against the k2-lean form of record.
fits_die_sram_7nm: no (the gigabyte 8.6 Gbit); a chip's SRAM an attempt 3 KiB
red_team_chip_row: pending: the panel's row on the dependent chain (the fabric's reconfiguration per entry cannot be scheduled ahead of the entry's end; at one step an entry the reconfiguration is every step)
floating: integer-only as mode 3's: no exponent mask anywhere in the attempt; the floating counters read 0 on every set
fixed_cost: bytes hashed a hash as the lean occupancy form's (the work seed 72, the programme seed 72, the period seed 80 once a period, the init 72, the lean mix 32 + 32 + 128 + 256, the final digest 64) plus 128 fold-and-draw chains of 17 operations at the entries' ends
